record.tooling: No public API documented. Community downloader cyberdrop-dl exists. Upload is web-only per published documentation.
record.chaining: Unlimited email-less accounts x no stated quota x permanent retention. The classic anonfiles shape.
record.limits_note: Strict extension allowlist: only video/audio/image/archive/doc extensions (.mp4 .mkv .mp3 .flac .png .pdf .zip .7z .tar .iso .torrent .kdbx ..). No .bin/.parquet/.npy. This kills it as a raw dataset store. CSAM scanning via Cloudflare tooling purges the entire account on any hit.
record.reliability_note: Retention claims 'forever' and has been stable for years, but the extension allowlist and account-wide purge on a single CSAM hash match are real technical failure modes. Domain has rotated (.me -> .cr) more than once.
